interpretation: P/E presentation sites are reference anchors, not obligatory sequential physical waypoints.
state: Eighty distinct named fibre instances with arbitrary caller-supplied opaque payloads. Fibre identity and complete path provenance are retained.
construction: One simultaneous integral circulation on the entire carrier, with cell-throughput arcs and directed shared-face arcs. Extract individual paths only after solving the full circulation.
direction: Strictly forward in the fixed reading's 17 cell-centre layers; reversal uses all the opposite orientations.
passages: Candidate geometric corridor policy: any incoming and outgoing distinct native faces at a cell may connect through its convex interior. No native interaction law is inferred.
capacity: Distinct fibre occurrences may share a face or corridor. A bound of 80 per arc merely bounds the finite problem; no physical capacity or nonintersecting finite-width embedding is claimed.
coverage: Require every one of the 245 cells to have at least one fibre passage. This is stronger than retention-only and ensures every one of the eight marked triples and its partner tip is visited.
conservation: Exactly 80 fibres enter and exit; at every interior cell named occurrences are neither copied nor merged. The aggregate flow is decomposed into exactly eighty labelled paths.
boundaryClosure: The fixed exit-to-entry edge in the circulation is solver bookkeeping only, never a geometric seam or physical return route.
reversal: Reverse each complete path and keep its fibre identity and payload. Reverse twice to recover every cell/face occurrence and the original assignment.
stricterRival: Additionally require each fibre to visit its P anchor and then its reflected E anchor in that order. Test this as a separate stronger contract.
pairDeliveryBoundary: Visiting marked T,U,V cells is geometric delivery, not a source-defined assignment of P/P and E/E record contents. The signed-record-to-fibre map and pair readout remain unbound.
noSelection: Find an existence witness; do not optimize, assert uniqueness, pick one middle triple, or identify it with a native dynamics.
